rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: it counts events and censored samples and reports median follow-up before the model, filters with filterByExpr and normalizes with TMM to a log-CPM matrix, scores with UCell while reporting how many of the 20 genes are present, fits a Cox model with the standardized continuous score plus case/control status, reports HR per SD with 95% CI, checks proportional hazards with scaled Schoenfeld residuals, and keeps the KM-by-tertile plot as display only. The rms::cph substitution for survival::coxph is explicitly stated and methodologically equivalent. Minor gaps: the reference level of case/control is not named, the p-value is not specified as the likelihood-ratio test, the QC step flags outliers without stating a removal/retention policy, and the aside claiming DESeq2/edgeR inflate false positives at n=60/group is unsupported though inconsequential here. Enrichment is correctly and explicitly omitted, and the report step is thorough on versions, provenance, thresholds, and caveats.
